sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1. RULE.

Learned APP waives service of rule for the respondent-State.
2.

The present application is filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for regular bail in connection with FIR being C.R.NO.11202058230009 of 2023 registered with Cyber Crime Police Station, Jamnagar for offence under Sections 419 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 43, 66, 66(C) and 66(D) of the Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008.
3. Learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that considering the nature of the offence, the applicant may be enlarged on regular bail by imposing suitable conditions.

sentences.text: 1 4. Learned APP appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has opposed grant of regular bail looking to the nature and gravity of the offence.
5. I have heard the learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties and perused the papers.

The role attributed to the present applicant in commission of offence in question is to the effect that he had hacked the face-book account of the first informant, and thereafter, demand for money was raised from the persons, who were in the contact list of the first informant and accordingly, some amount was collected from them.
The persons in whose account the amount had gone have been considered for grant of bail by the Sessions Court.

6. This Court has also taken into consideration the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation, reported in [2012]1 SCC 40.
7.

entities.text: Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation, reported in [2012]1 SCC 40
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of the allegations made against the applicant in the FIR, without discussing the evidence in detail, prima facie, this Court is of the opinion that this is a fit case to exercise the discretion and enlarge the applicant on regular bail.
8. Hence, the present application is allowed.
The authorities will release the applicant only if he is not required in connection with any other offence for the time being.

If breach of any of the above conditions is committed, the Sessions Judge Priteshbhai @ Gogi Maheshbhai ... vs State Of Gujarat on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142192698/
2 concerned will be free to issue warrant or take appropriate action in the matter.

entities.text: Sessions Judge Priteshbhai @ Gogi Maheshbhai ... vs State Of Gujarat
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 10. Bail bond to be executed before the lower Court having jurisdiction to try the case.
It will be open for the concerned Court to delete, modify and/or relax any of the above conditions, in accordance with law.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/18672/2023 ORDER DATED: 18/10/2023 undefined 11.
At the trial, the trial Court shall not be influenced by the observations of preliminary nature qua the evidence at this stage made by this Court while enlarging the applicant on bail.
12. Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.
